Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival in Sugar Land, Texas, I found a rear-end collision involving two vehicles. Driver 1 was
stopped in the travel lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of the stopped car. Driver 1 reported
pain in the lower back and said the impcat pushed them forward against the seatbelt before rebounding into the seat.
The severity of the impact appears consistent with that account. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle. A Passenger was also present in the front seat, and both the statements of the drivers and the
other occupant confirm that Driver 1 was inside the car at the time of impact. Damage to the rear bumper and trunk of
Driver 1's vehicle matches the direction and force described by both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene confirm
the general layout and damage, though no independent witnesses came forward. Some older faint scratches were
noted on the rear panel, which may predate this collision and will need to be reviewed separately. Driver 2 was
cooperative and provided insurance information at the scene.
</page>
